newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Gener to issue 4yr, 9pct convertible.
newsitem.headline: Greek Gener to issue 4yr, 9pct convertible.

text.p: Greek construction firm Gener will issue a four-year, 9.0 percent convertible bond worth 1.399 billion drachmas following the approval by its extraordinary shareholders meeting on Friday, it said in a statement.
The firm will issue 84,333 bonds with a face value of 16,600 drachmas convertible into common registered shares, it said.
"Each shareholder of Gener has the right to participate in the bond loan with the purchase of one bond for 90 outstanding shares," it added.
The conversion ratio is one bond for 10 common registered shares with a face value of 370 drachmas, it added.
The stated conversion price for the first two years will be equal to 1,660 drachmas per share rising to 1,830 drachmas for the third year and 2,000 drachmas in the fourth year, it said.
All or part of the convertible bond issue will be callable after the first year, it said.
Greek ETEVA bank served as advisor and lead underwriter for the convertible issue. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
